metadata.case_name: WONG BIK CHUEN v. HUA MIN TOURISM AUTOMOBILE TRANSPORT CO LTD

injuries.description: lower lip trauma with a wound of 3 x 2 cm
source: (1) lower lip trauma with a wound of 3 x 2 cm;
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: dislocation of two lower central incisors (teeth No. 31 and 41)
source: (2) dislocation of two lower central incisors (teeth No. 31 and 41);
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of periodontal tissues

injuries.description: subluxation with grade II mobility of two lower lateral incisors (teeth Nos. 32 and 42)
source: (3) subluxation with grade II mobility of two lower lateral incisors, (teeth Nos. 32 and 42).

manifestations.description: he was bleeding from the mouth
he also found his lower front incisors became loose immediately after the accident
pain and discomfort of his teeth and gum
infection of his teeth and gum
his condition had affected his speech
gone through a few months of discomfort and pain after the accident

treatments_received: reduction of displaced and subluxed teeth under local anaesthetics
root canal treatments of the four affected teeth to relieve his pain and infection
lower incisors were stabilised with wire braces and brackets
treatments_future: endodontic treatment (conservative plan) as described by Dr William C W Yung
teeth implant treatment (Dr William C W Yung's recommended plan)

losses.description: Pain, discomfort, bleeding and infection of his teeth and gum following the accident
Condition had affected his speech; he could not speak properly after the accident due to the injury to his lip and teeth

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Delay in the construction of his new house because he was not able to closely supervise the building works; court allowed HK$15,000 for this delay
